mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.prj_id,a.dev_id,a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt,a.asgn_rt,a.asgn_stts_cd, p.prj_stts_cd,p.use_yn,COALESCE(a.updated_at,a.created_at) AS updated_at FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id}

SELECT TO_CHAR(g.month,'YYYY-MM') AS work_ym, COALESCE(m.auto_mm_qty,ROUND( (LEAST(a.end_dt,(g.month + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date) - GREATEST(a.bgn_dt,g.month::date) + 1)::numeric / EXTRACT(DAY FROM g.month + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day') * a.asgn_rt,2)) AS auto_mm_qty, COALESCE(m.mm_qty,0) AS mm_qty,COALESCE(m.mnl_yn,'N') AS mnl_yn, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(other.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth other JOIN asgn.asgn owner ON owner.asgn_id=other.asgn_id WHERE owner.dev_id=a.dev_id AND owner.asgn_stts_cd <> 'CANCELLED' AND other.work_ym=TO_CHAR(g.month,'YYYY-MM')),0) AS person_month_mm_qty, CASE WHEN c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS closed_yn FROM asgn.asgn a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(DATE_TRUNC('month',a.bgn_dt::timestamp), DATE_TRUNC('month',a.end_dt::timestamp),INTERVAL '1 month') AS g(month) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=TO_CHAR(g.month,'YYYY-MM') LEFT JOIN fin.mth_cls c ON c.cls_ym=TO_CHAR(g.month,'YYYY-MM') WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY g.month

SELECT 'PRE_CONTRACT' AS code,'미계약 선투입' AS message,NULL::text AS work_ym FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd <> 'CANCELLED' AND p.prj_stts_cd='PLAN' UNION ALL SELECT 'ON_LEAVE','휴직 기간 배정',NULL::text FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd <> 'CANCELLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=a.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt <= a.end_dt AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt >= a.bgn_dt)) UNION ALL SELECT 'DISPATCH_NONREG','파견에 프리랜서·외주 배정',NULL::text FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd <> 'CANCELLED' AND p.cntrct_ty_cd='DP' AND d.emp_se_cd IN ('FL','OS')

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn b ON b.prj_id=a.prj_id AND b.dev_id=a.dev_id AND b.asgn_id <> a.asgn_id AND b.asgn_stts_cd <> 'CANCELLED' AND b.bgn_dt <= a.end_dt AND b.end_dt >= a.bgn_dt WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id})
